summary: Number of final images returned by one Image API request. GPT Image 2 accepts 1 through 10; increasing it multiplies output volume, image-token cost, processing time, settlement work, and the number of branches the UI must represent.
combines: The selected size, quality, background, and output format apply to every returned image, so higher `n` multiplies the cost of those choices.
`partial_images` controls progressive previews and does not replace `n`; previews must still be associated with the correct final output.
Lixpi currently settles one output per media run. Multi-output identity, progress, placement, and lineage require the separate implementation investigation recorded on this parameter.
note: Our ui does not support rendering multiple outputs, you must figure out how to present it. Don't make decision on your own, propose options and wait for my input
